raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

This PR adds an AITER fusion pass for the MLA input projection. It fuses the GEMM, the q/kv RMSNorm and the q per-token FP8 quant. Requires https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6850.

## Claims

- MI355X, DeepSeek-R1 MXFP4 `fused_qkv_a_proj` (N=2112, K=7168): GEMM + q/kv RMSNorm + q per-token FP8 quant is 0.9–5.2 µs faster per layer for decode batches M <= 256, -5% to -40%.

## Validation

### Commands

```bash
# serve
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1
export VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_SKINNY_GEMM=0
vllm serve amd/DeepSeek-R1-0528-MXFP4-MTP-MoEFP4 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \
  --dtype auto \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --disable-uvicorn-access-log \
  --max-model-len 32768 \
  --max-num-seqs 512 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  -cc.use_inductor_graph_partition=True \
  -cc.pass_config.fuse_rope_kvcache_cat_mla=True

# bench
vllm bench serve \
  --model amd/DeepSeek-R1-0528-MXFP4-MTP-MoEFP4 \
  --backend vllm \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --base-url "http://localhost:8000" \
  --dataset-name random \
  --random-input-len 1024 \
  --random-output-len 1024 \
  --num-prompts $((CONC * 10)) \
  --max-concurrency $CONC \
  --request-rate inf \
  --ignore-eos \
  --temperature 0 \
  --save-result \
  --result-dir . \
  --percentile-metrics "ttft,tpot,itl,e2el"

# accuracy
lm_eval \
  --model local-completions \
  --model_args "model=/shareddata/amd/DeepSeek-R1-0528-MXFP4-MTP-MoEFP4,base_url=http://localhost:8000/v1/completions,num_concurrent=64,max_retries=3,tokenized_requests=False,tokenizer_backend=None,trust_remote_code=True" \
  --tasks gsm8k \
  --num_fewshot 20 \
  --seed 42
```

### Accuracy

Before:

|Tasks|Version|     Filter     |n-shot|  Metric   |   |Value |   |Stderr|
|-----|------:|----------------|-----:|-----------|---|-----:|---|-----:|
|gsm8k|      3|flexible-extract|    20|exact_match|↑  |0.9492|±  |0.0060|
|     |       |strict-match    |    20|exact_match|↑  |0.9469|±  |0.0062|

After:

|Tasks|Version|     Filter     |n-shot|  Metric   |   |Value |   |Stderr|
|-----|------:|----------------|-----:|-----------|---|-----:|---|-----:|
|gsm8k|      3|flexible-extract|    20|exact_match|↑  |0.9575|±  |0.0056|
|     |       |strict-match    |    20|exact_match|↑  |0.9568|±  |0.0056|

### Benchmarks

| Concurrency | Output token throughput before (tok/s) | Output token throughput after (tok/s) | Speedup | Median TTFT before (ms) | Median TTFT after (ms) | Speedup | Median TPOT before (ms) | Median TPOT after (ms) | Speedup |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 16 | 1305.69 | 1310.65 | 1.004x | 250.41 | 242.50 | 1.033x | 12.00 | 11.96 | 1.003x |
| 64 | 3902.70 | 3914.35 | 1.003x | 352.93 | 350.52 | 1.007x | 16.03 | 15.98 | 1.003x |
| 128 | 6176.62 | 6234.65 | 1.009x | 435.58 | 432.41 | 1.007x | 20.26 | 20.10 | 1.008x |

## Details

- Measured on `gfx950`.

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.
This needs an aiter version/function signature check before the op and pattern are used.
Does this pattern need to be so specific in the shapes that it operates on?

+class MLAQkvAProjDualRMSPerTokenQuantPattern(MLADualRMSPerTokenQuantPattern):
+    """Fuse the MLA input projection ``fused_qkv_a_proj`` GEMM,
+    q-latent RMSNorm + FP8 per-token quant and kv-latent RMSNorm into
+    ``fused_mla_qkv_a_proj_dual_rms_norm_per_token_quant``. Other weight shapes
+    keep the GEMM and get ``fused_mla_dual_rms_norm_per_token_quant``.

+
+        def _pattern(
+            x: torch.Tensor,
+            weight: torch.Tensor,
+            x_scale: torch.Tensor,
+            weight_scale: torch.Tensor,
+            q_weight: torch.Tensor,
+            kv_weight: torch.Tensor,

+            projected = self.GEMM_OP(

+            )
+            return dual_rms_norm_quant(projected, q_weight, kv_weight)
+
+        return _pattern
+

+        eps = self._epsilon

nodes.body: For now yes, because the choice whether to use the Triton/HIP norm kernel were measured only for this shape, and AITER only has a tuned Triton preshuffle config for N=2112, K=7168. In the future, we can relax this gate once the kernel is tuned for other model shapes, but for now, I added the gate as I didn't want to risk any regressions with other models.

files.patch:
@@ -1810,6 +1810,80 @@ def _fused_mla_dual_rms_norm_per_token_quant_fake(
     return q_out, q_scale, kv_normed
 
 
+def _fused_mla_qkv_a_proj_dual_rms_norm_per_token_quant_impl(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    x_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    weight_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    q_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    kv_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    q_epsilon: float,
+    kv_epsilon: float,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """MLA per-token FP8 fused_qkv_a_proj + q/kv RMSNorm + q per-token quant."""
+    from aiter.ops.triton.fused_fp8_quant import fused_reduce_rms_fp8_group_quant
+    from aiter.ops.triton.gemm_a8w8 import gemm_a8w8_preshuffle
+
+    from vllm.triton_utils import triton
+
+    q_dim, kv_dim = q_weight.shape[0], kv_weight.shape[0]
+    if x.shape[0] > 512:
+        y = _rocm_aiter_preshuffled_per_token_w8a8_gemm_impl(
+            x, weight, x_scale, weight_scale, None, torch.bfloat16
+        )
+    else:
+        # (NUM_KSPLIT, M, N) fp32 partials, or (M, N) bf16 if the config has no split
+        y = gemm_a8w8_preshuffle(
+            x,
+            weight.view(weight.shape[0] // 16, -1),
+            x_scale,
+            weight_scale.view(1, -1),
+            skip_reduce=True,
+        )
+    q, kv, k_pe = y.split([q_dim, kv_dim, weight.shape[0] - q_dim - kv_dim], dim=-1)
+    if 512 < x.shape[0] <= 1024:
+        q_out, q_scale, kv_normed = _fused_mla_dual_rms_norm_per_token_quant_impl(
+            q, q_weight, kv, kv_weight, q_epsilon, kv_epsilon
+        )
+        return q_out, q_scale, kv_normed, k_pe.contiguous()
+    split_k = y.dim() == 3
+    (q_out, q_scale), _, kv_normed, _, k_pe_out = fused_reduce_rms_fp8_group_quant(
+        q,
+        q_weight,
+        q_epsilon,
+        kv,
+        kv_weight,
+        kv_epsilon,
+        k_pe if split_k else None,
+        # One quant group spans the whole q row: per-token quant.
